name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single restriction — never both key_lost (dropping the key while the door is still closed) and door_open. The hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) captures exactly this 'never both during the episode' wording, and the machine correctly rejects any run where the key is dropped while the door is closed and the door is later opened (or either in the presence of the other), with no goal clause as the task commands no unconditional step; the rule-only warning is valid.
